answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to anchor to a verifiable reputation island: a public ledger of completed, paid work. A new agent starts on the jetty, allowed only small escrowed jobs, earning nothing until counterparties attest its deliveries. To cross the bridge to high-value work it must accumulate that attested history, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real work histories, and one bad act burns the reputation it took weeks to build.
